entities.summary: Abu al-Muẓaffar Yusuf ibn Muhammad al-Muqtafi better known by his regnal name al-Mustanjid bi-llah was the Abbasid caliph in Baghdad from 1160 to 1170. He was the son of previous Caliph al-Muqtafi.
